property_summary: For any block whose number is not a multiple of 15, a successful fallback call must increase the contract's balance by exactly the msg.value sent; the buggy contract accepts 1 ether but a 10-ether call reverts, so a 10-ether call that succeeds on the reference will fail on the buggy contract, while a 1-ether call succeeding on the buggy contract will fail on the reference.
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 1 ether, altering which calls succeed and thus the contract balance and transfer eligibility.
